implementationBoundaries: Use explicit scene/equipment selection; never regroup every indicator or accessory by type.
Adapt presentation after composition and before point/interactor initialization; preserve equipment IDs, labels, actions, point bindings and KIN/LENS/controller child paths.
Ray picking uses all visible meshes under bound equipment roots: bench/cabinet/wiring decorative supports must be unbound sibling nodes, otherwise they enlarge clickable targets.
Preserve pushbutton/estop local feedback transforms and selector detents; cached feedback transforms must be initialized after mounting.
Provide stable mounting for every relocated component; hide only verified authored pedestal/base meshes, never arbitrary prefix guesses.
Retain field geometry and process axes; avoid moving sensors/actuators or decorative colliders/I/O.

Retain authored camera target/envelope; validate panel legibility, occlusion, click rays and reset in actual full/split views. Compacting a wide control layout may alter fit bounds and needs explicit framing policy.
Wiring context is illustrative passive geometry, not an electrical design or commissioning/safety claim.

Prefer no-motion support addition with unchanged component world positions where it makes a coherent bench; compact panels require actual transforms, not decorative cabinets beside unchanged floor buttons.
